notes: Qty 59 as published: the section counts (Objective 1, Characters 25, Locations 7, Ships 3, Devices 2, Weapons 2, Effects 11, Interrupts 8) add to 59 and match the list.
The starting Effect varies by matchup in the strategy (Bargaining Table, Aim High, Scramble or Ultimatum), so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'You Can Either Profit By This/' + 'Or Be Destroyed' (two lines) is the one Objective. 'Jabba's Palace' (listed under Locations next to 'Audience Chamber') dested Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Entrance Cavern' Jabba's Palace: Entrance Cavern; 'Tosche Station', 'Jundland Wastes', 'Cantina', 'Mos Eisley' the Tatooine sites.

Posted 'Nar Shadaa' (listed under Interrupts) dested Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes, not the Nar Shaddaa system. 'Vader's Impotence (Uncontrollable Fury)' dested Uncontrollable Fury; 'Savrip' Mantellian Savrip; 'OTE' Order To Engage; 'The Singal' The Signal.

Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace); 'See Threepio' See-Threepio; 'C-3P0' C-3PO (See-Threepio); 'Han Solo (Hansickle)' Han Solo; 'Chewiew/Gun' Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando w/gun' Lando With Blaster Pistol; 'Boush' Boushh; 'Epp Leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle.
